player_prompt.intro:
Ove uge u Player {player_id} mu JoJoJoin, otchiwa ku tchibola 5x5 na selulas numeradas 0-24.
Pa ku tchimbila, koka simbolo lako ku selula yoye isikala, p.e. '[12]'.
OGE UWINA ngwa kupata simbolo lako zine ku selulas zine mfululizo — selulas zine mfululizo wa mpwita, wa kusimama, kana wa diagonal.
Ku u Player {player_id} ove u '{symbol}'; uge wa kupambana na ove u '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: Ovalepo osi, ka a supile. {cell} Ka yi kuete esilivilo. Yi sukila oku kala pokati keci 0 la 24.

outcome.draw: Momo omapalo yaco ya kala ndu okuti, ka va kuatele omunu ukuavo o yi yula.
